body.name: \(\theta^t\)
body.construction: For any \(\theta=((p_i,q_i))_{i=1}^{n}\in\Theta_{G,s}\) and a chosen edge \(j\to i\), embed the reflected edge-specific version of \(\theta^{\mathrm{sp}}\) in \(G\) and set \(p_\ell^t=(1-t)p_\ell+t p_\ell^{\mathrm{sp}}\) and \(q_\ell^t=(1-t)q_\ell+t q_\ell^{\mathrm{sp}}\) for \(t\in[0,1]\).
